meaning: Every Cosmicflows-4 galaxy between 3 and 200 Mpc, drawn whole while the camera is within 100 Mpc.
basis: Presentation choice: all 27,277 galaxies in one level, unthinned, so clusters and filaments keep the contrast the catalogue measured; it is flux-limited, so it is denser near the Milky Way. Drawn whole within 100 Mpc, half its radius; farther out a share that falls with distance. At most 25,000 of its dots are drawn at once (screenBudget): past that, a fixed share is kept, so zooming never swaps one dot for another; below it, every dot is drawn.
